messages:
maya_a (AE): FYI customer (NovaBank) just sent an enterprise requirements list. POC kickoff tomorrow. Main asks: SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM user/group sync, RBAC support, domain enforcement, audit logs. Need a short runbook + any pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted+VPC.

carlos_it (NovaBank): thanks Maya. Correct — Okta SSO + SCIM. We also require NameID = email, persistent NameID, and group-based role assignment from SCIM groups. Can Redwood map SCIM groups to roles? Also require domain allowlist (lock to @novabank.com) and ability to disable self-signup.

maya_a (AE): @carlos_it yes, we can map SCIM groups to our RBAC roles in the app. Tom, can you outline the POC steps and what metadata we need from their IdP?

tom_se (Solutions Eng): Quick checklist for the POC:
1) Get SAML metadata XML from Okta (or IdP SSO URL + cert).
2) SCIM base URL + token (we'll run provisioning in test mode).
3) List of group-to-role mappings customer expects.
4) Test accounts (one admin, one manager, one regular).
5) Expected traffic profile for Dedicated sizing.

Also we need to confirm whether they want JIT provisioning or SCIM-only provisioning. If groups are required for RBAC, SCIM group push is preferred.

carlos_it (NovaBank): we'll do SCIM group push. JIT is off. We'll share metadata + SCIM token today.

priya_sec (Security): A few security items to confirm:
- SAML assertions signed + encrypted? We support signed assertions; encryption is optional but supported for Private installs.
- SCIM over TLS with token rotation recommended.
- Audit logs retention and export: we retain auth/audit logs for 90 days by default on Hosted; Dedicated/Private can extend.

For the questionnaire: please ask them to fill the standard security worksheet (link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-questionnaire). We need their encryption at rest requirements and KMS preferences (AWS KMS or customer HSM).

maya_a (AE): @priya_sec they want customer-managed KMS (AWS). I'll attach the questionnaire in the sales portal.

sam_fin (Finance): Pricing note: Hosted + VPC has lower monthly commitment but limited domain isolation. Dedicated (reserved GPUs) adds a baseline capacity cost. For an enterprise with strict SSO/SCIM + 99.9 SLA + audit retention 1yr, estimate ~ $18k/mo committed. Hosted+VPC with PAYG might be ~ $8-10k/mo depending on tokens. I'll prepare a short comparison for tomorrow's call.

deploy-bot: New POC workspace created: workspace-novabank-17825. Link: https://console.redwood.example.com/workspaces/novabank-17825

tom_se (Solutions Eng): SCIM attribute mapping snippet (example for Okta -> Redwood RBAC):
```
scim.mapping = {
  "groups": {
    "okta:Engineering": "role:engineer",
    "okta:Admins": "role:admin"
  },
  "user": {
    "username": "userName",
    "email": "emails[0].value",
    "name": "profile.firstName + ' ' + profile.lastName"
  }
}
```

tom_se (Solutions Eng): Also for SAML config, request: SSO URL, Entity ID, x509 cert, and desired NameID format (we'll prefer Persistent/Email). Example NameID config we support: `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`.

carlos_it (NovaBank): noted. Also need to verify if Redwood supports domain-based auto-allowlist for service accounts (we want only novabank.com emails to sign up).

priya_sec (Security): Yes — we can enforce domain allowlist on account creation + block social signups. For Hosted customers we enforce via VPC + policy; for Private you get customer-managed directory sync options. We'll include the enforcement options in the questionnaire follow-up.

maya_a (AE): Action items:
- Carlos: send Okta metadata + SCIM token + desired group->role mapping (today).
- Tom: prepare POC runbook + test plan (deliver before EOD).
- Priya: attach relevant security checklist and confirm KMS flow.
- Sam: price comparison doc for Dedicated vs Hosted+VPC (deliver tomorrow).

carlos_it (NovaBank): I'll upload the artifacts to the workspace and ping here when done. Thanks everyone. :pray:

tom_se (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the runbook in the workspace and include test cases: SAML login success/failure, SCIM group sync, role enforcement, audit export.

maya_a (AE): Great — I'll send calendar invites for the POC kickoff 10:00 PDT tomorrow.

sam_fin (Finance): FYI — if they want 1yr log retention add-on, that's an extra ~$2k/mo.

carlos_it (NovaBank): ok, on calendar. Uploading metadata now.
